Package com.example.impact.utils.role

Class AdminDb

java.lang.Object
com.example.impact.utils.role.AdminDb
public final class AdminDb extends Object
Aggregates all administrator-facing Firestore operations.

All methods in this class target top-level collections (such as events/ and users/) or traverse nested subcollections under events/{eventId} in order to gather global data like event lists, profile lists, or event-scoped images. Controllers and activities should prefer these helpers over building Firestore paths manually.
